notes.title: Release Date Issues!!!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!! 

We are having issues with our release since there is not a buy button and we are already contacted steam to help us solve this problem and we are waiting for their response.

We are really sorry but we hope we have some more news real soon!

Thanks!

notes.title: Pato Box Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We just announced the game will release on [b]March 16 of 2018![/b] 
Just a couple of week away!

We also revealed a new trailer! There is a lot of new gameplay in there for you guys. Tell your friends, tell your pets, tell everyone!
